name: Fabric Self-Service Access Request
description: Workflow for requesting access to Fabric workspace resources via Purview Unified Catalog. Includes ServiceNow ticketing (stubbed) and automated Fabric provisioning.

actions.description: Step 1 — Notify the data steward/owner that a new access request was submitted.

inputs.subject: New Fabric access request from @{triggerBody().requestor.displayName}

actions.description: Step 2 — Call the ServiceNow stub Function App to create a tracking ticket. Replace {{SERVICENOW_URL}} with your deployed Function App URL.
Step 3 — Create an approval task for the data steward/admin. The approver sees the request details and the ServiceNow ticket reference.

inputs.title: Fabric access request: @{triggerBody().requestor.displayName} → @{triggerBody().resource.displayName}

actions.description: Step 4 — Branch on approval outcome. If approved, enqueue the provisioning request. If rejected, notify the requestor.

ifTrue.description: POST to ServiceNow stub to update ticket status to approved. The stub's timer trigger will auto-enqueue a Storage Queue message for the Fabric provisioner.
Notify requestor that approval was granted; provisioning is in progress.

inputs.subject: Access request approved — provisioning in progress

ifFalse.description: Update ServiceNow ticket status to rejected.
Notify requestor that the access request was denied.

inputs.subject: Access request denied — @{triggerBody().resource.displayName}

actions.description: Step 5 — Wait for the Fabric provisioner Azure Function to call back via the Purview Workflow API with the provisioning result.
Step 6 — Send final notification to the requestor with the provisioning outcome.

inputs.subject: Fabric access provisioned — @{triggerBody().resource.displayName}
